name: micro-transitions
title: Micro Transitions
description: UI micro-transition pack for vertical reels: a bell badge pops, a tooltip, a modal and a dropdown rise into place, a check draws and a segmented tab pill slides, all from one progress value. Badge, tooltip and travel are fields. Brand palette, Montserrat, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="micro-transitions": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Badge
variables.description: Count inside the notification badge on the bell.

variables.label: Tooltip
variables.description: Wording inside the small dark tooltip.

variables.label: Travel
variables.description: Scales how far every panel starts from its resting place before it settles.
